hook: Tumors grown in mice pick up mouse virus DNA. About 25% of models carry it.

readout.label: PDX datasets with human-MLV chimeric DNA

summary: Screening 1,619 sequencing runs from patient-derived xenograft models, the authors found murine leukemia virus DNA joined to human DNA in roughly a quarter of them. Most junctions showed true retroviral integration signatures, and a full ecotropic virus copy was confirmed by long-read and Sanger sequencing. It is a preprint built on public data, so contamination or sample-specific artifacts in individual datasets cannot be fully excluded.
title: Prevalent Integration of both Xenotropic and Ecotropic Murine Leukemia Virus in the Human Genome of Xenografts
